description: This file defines an interface for managing signal handlers in a program. It provides functions to push and pop signal handlers onto a stack, handle common signals collectively, and restore previous handlers. The design aims to allow multiple parts of a program to install cleanup handlers that can be safely stacked and restored.

methods.name: sigchain_push
methods.description: Pushes a signal handler onto the stack for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_pop
methods.description: Removes the most recent handler for a specific signal from the stack.

methods.name: sigchain_push_common
methods.description: Pushes a handler for the common signals (SIGINT, SIGHUP, SIGTERM, SIGQUIT, SIGPIPE).

methods.name: sigchain_pop_common
methods.description: Restores the previous handlers for the common signals.
